instruction.text: Complete the sentence with the correct indefinite pronoun.

wrong.text:
Indefinite pronouns do not name or refer to any specific thing or person.

Here are some examples:

Do you need anything?
I asked someone for help.
I brought everything.

atoms.b: Is there ((++anything everything)) I can help you with?

atoms.b: ((++Everyone Anyone)) had a great time at your party.
atoms.finishSound: Everyone had a great time at your party.
